blueprint_book.label: Progressive Rails
blueprint_book.description:
Rail blueprints are arranged into upgradable tiers. All tiers are arranged on the same grid, so they can be upgraded in place. Read the Tier 2 description for upgrade instructions.

* Left hand drive
* Length 4 trains
* Demand-based trains

Codes used in blueprint names:

P: Power/Pole
B: Bot (Roboport)
PB: Power and Bot
CB: City Block
T{N}: Tier N
L{N}: Length N
LHD: Left Hand Drive
